dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent O-shaped structures on the mid-dorsal region exhibit irregular, crenulated perimeters with a high-frequency spatial transition from dark charcoal exterior pixels to light grey/white interior pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light grey pixel clusters located predominantly on the anterior shoulder and posterior flank, characterized by localized pixel saturation lacking internal radial gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the vertex of the largest angle positioned more laterally toward the right flank.
